newsitem.title: UK: UK shoppers reject recommended price ban - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK shoppers reject recommended price ban - survey.

text.p: More than two thirds of British shoppers prefer recommended retail prices and do not want them scrapped, according to a survey commissioned by the British Radio and Electronic Equipment Manufacturers' Association.

The organisation commissioned the survey after press reports suggested Britain's competition watchdog, the Monopolies and Mergers Commission, wanted to ban recommended retail prices in the electrical goods industry.

The survey, conducted by polling group MORI, covered a representative sample of 1,858 adults aged 18 or over and 68 percent said they found recommended retail prices helpful and did not want them discontinued.
